mapper.update: UPDATE T_MP_ADJUST_RESULT SET BEGIN_DAY = #{beginDay}, END_DAY = #{endDay}, DAY_1 = #{day1}, DAY_2 = #{day2}, DAY_3 = #{day3}, DAY_4 = #{day4}, DAY_5 = #{day5}, DAY_6 = #{day6}, DAY_7 = #{day7}, DAY_8 = #{day8}, DAY_9 = #{day9}, DAY_10 = #{day10}, DAY_11 = #{day11}, DAY_12 = #{day12}, DAY_13 = #{day13}, DAY_14 = #{day14}, DAY_15 = #{day15}, DAY_16 = #{day16}, DAY_17 = #{day17}, DAY_18 = #{day18}, DAY_19 = #{day19}, DAY_20 = #{day20}, DAY_21 = #{day21}, DAY_22 = #{day22}, DAY_23 = #{day23}, DAY_24 = #{day24}, DAY_25 = #{day25}, DAY_26 = #{day26}, DAY_27 = #{day27}, DAY_28 = #{day28}, DAY_29 = #{day29}, DAY_30 = #{day30}, DAY_31 = #{day31}, HEIGHT_PRODUCTION_QTY = #{heightProductionQty}, MID_PRODUCTION_QTY = #{midProductionQty}, CYCLE_PRODUCTION_QTY = #{cycleProductionQty}, CONVENTION_PRODUCTION_QTY = #{conventionProductionQty}, POSTPONE_PRODUCTION_QTY = #{postponeProductionQty}, TRIAL_PRODUCTION_QTY = #{trialProductionQty}, IS_LOCK_SCHEDULE = #{isLockSchedule}, TOTAL_QTY = #{totalQty}, ADJUST_FLAG = #{adjustFlag}, LAST_MONTH_OVERDUE_QTY = #{lastMonthOverdueQty}, LAST_MONTH_VALID_FLAG = #{lastMonthValidFlag}, UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() WHERE ID = #{id}

update.foreach: UPDATE T_MP_ADJUST_RESULT SET LAST_MONTH_VALID_FLAG = #{item.lastMonthValidFlag}, UPDATE_BY = #{item.updateBy}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() WHERE ID = #{item.id}

mapper.select: SELECT r.FACTORY_CODE, r.PRODUCTION_VERSION, r.VERSION, r.ADJUST_TYPE, r.UPDATE_BY, MAX(u.NICK_NAME) UPDATE_BY_NAME, MAX(r.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME FROM T_MP_ADJUST_RESULT r LEFT JOIN SYS_USER u ON u.USER_NAME = r.UPDATE_BY AND u.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE r.IS_DELETE = 0 AND r.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND r.YEAR = #{year} AND r.MONTH = #{month} AND r.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{monthPlanVersion}, '%') AND r.VERSION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{version}, '%') AND r.ADJUST_TYPE = #{adjustType} AND r.UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy} GROUP BY r.FACTORY_CODE, r.PRODUCTION_VERSION, r.VERSION, r.ADJUST_TYPE, r.UPDATE_BY ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC
